Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

LineColorExpression.description:
Retains native color operations and their owning style context. Colors are
not sampled/quantized during line inheritance; color evaluation is separate.

LineProfile.description:
Explicit interpretation of the documented multi-pass DrawingML rules.
This is not a certificate for a particular Office/WPS version or renderer.

NativePercentage.description: Exact native percentage: int32 thousandths of a percent or decimal percent; ranges depend on use.

objects.description: Request order is retained, including duplicates.

oneOf.description: Missing relationship or matching placeholder; no synthetic geometry.
Slide idx=0xffffffff is explicitly detached from layout matching.
